## Description

Uses convolutional or recurrent neural networks over order-book depth snapshots to predict short-horizon price movement or order-flow dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Very short horizons in liquid order-driven markets with sufficient high-quality labeled L2 data.

## Vehicles

HFT, electronic market-making and specialist futures/equity microstructure desks.

## Required data

Sequential L2 book snapshots, event-time data, trade/quote labels, queue changes, fees, latency and matching rules.

## Caveats

Requires large licensed datasets and careful event-time validation; paper results do not imply deployable net edge after latency and fees.
